This FloPlast push-fit double socket branch is an essential component for robust wastewater drainage systems. Manufactured from lightweight uPVC, it offers strength and long-lasting durability for reliable plumbing installations. Its 92.5° angle facilitates efficient flow within soil pipe networks. The branch is designed with side bosses, allowing simple connection of both 32 and 40mm waste pipes to a 110mm soil stack, making it ideal for comprehensive plumbing projects, such as connecting sinks and appliances in kitchens and bathrooms. This push-fit system with ring seal joints ensures easy and secure installation, even handling high temperature waste discharges effectively.
